profile_text.body:
The website associated with DXC Technology Co in this record is dexus.com, and the text harvested from it describes Dexus, an Australasian real asset investment and funds management business. According to that text, Dexus has four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and manages a multi-billion dollar portfolio of infrastructure and real estate assets. The site cites Atlassian Central in Sydney, described as the world's tallest hybrid timber tower at more than 180 metres, and a Brisbane office conversion into 1,180 student beds. The site states that Dexus is listed on the ASX under the ticker DXS and includes standard disclaimers that information may change without notice and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The held record identifies DXC Technology Co as a for-profit public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with the ticker DXC and CIK 0001688568. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it. The record lists Virginia as a jurisdiction with 152 entries under law exposure.

The harvested site text and the held company record do not align: the site content describes Dexus and its ASX listing, while the record describes DXC Technology Co, a Virginia-headquartered company with a different ticker and CIK. No AI products or AI positioning appear in either the site text or the held facts.
